mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts above 550 (HOUST > 550) and industrial production above 90 (INDPRO > 90) indicate robust aggregate demand, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST > 550 and INDPRO > 90.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 100), capacity constraints prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 550 signal sustained consumer demand for residential construction, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 550.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with robust payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100000) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100000.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 360,000 (RSAFS > 360000) indicate strong consumer spending, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 360000.
